subject.title: Casa del Libro keeps active Mirakl offers for withdrawn stocks

question: For CDL live offers whose stock is already `WITHDRAWN` and whose `mk_casaDelLibro` row is absent, should the marketplace team prefer live Mirakl verification before local deletion, snapshot-based rehydration, or one-time cleanup plus a narrower code guard?
rationale: The code defect is clear, but the production-safe fix can touch hundreds of marketplace rows and needs an operational choice about Mirakl rate limits, duplicate withdrawals, and bulk correction.

options.title: Live verification before deletion
options.body: Keep local rows retryable until Mirakl proves the offer is inactive, reducing future orphaned offers at the cost of extra API calls.

options.title: Snapshot rehydration recovery
options.body: Use `cdl_listings` snapshots to recreate minimal retryable rows for active withdrawn SKUs, with strict dry-run controls.

options.title: One-time cleanup first
options.body: Retire the current orphaned offers operationally before changing batch semantics, reducing immediate oversell risk but leaving recurrence possible until code changes land.

recommendation.title: Live verification before deletion
recommendation.body: Keep local rows retryable until Mirakl proves the offer is inactive, reducing future orphaned offers at the cost of extra API calls.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the CDL production evidence and has recent history in the Casa del Libro marketplace API area.
